fn solve(n: Int, m: Int, a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (m >= 1)
  requires (a >= 1)
  requires (b >= 1)
  ensures (result == (if (((n % m) * b) < ((m - (n % m)) * a)) then ((n % m) * b) else ((m - (n % m)) * a)))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, 0, 0) == 0)
